shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot at night on the pavement outside a small independent cinema: the glowing marquee has a completely blank sign board, the posters in the glass cases are abstract and unreadable. Selin, a woman of 22 with long dark hair, an olive-green coat and a shoulder bag, stands with her hands in her pockets; Deniz, a man of 24 with short dark hair, round glasses and a denim jacket, leans against the wall beside her. Both look relaxed after the film. Warm street lamp light, wet pavement reflections. Vertical composition.
